summary: First Financial Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.56 per share. The board declared the dividend payable October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on October 1, 2026. First Financial is the holding company for First Financial Bank N.A., operating in Indiana, Illinois, Kentucky, Tennessee, and Georgia. No special-situation transaction, stake, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation for risk-arb purposes.
